Hi Michael,

I did a self-serve signup this morning and your product looks promising for a recommendation layer we want to add to Olive Interiors (we're a B2B marketplace for bespoke furniture). I'd love a short demo to see latency/cost profiles and how Redwood handles retrieval + embeddings.

Quick details so you have context:

- Traffic today: ~10k requests/day, expected to ramp to 200k/month during holiday peak
- Concurrency estimate: ~60–80 concurrent active users at peak
- Timeline: aiming for a Q4 2027 POC, shipping internal MVP shortly after

Hi Lina — great to meet you and thanks for the context. Happy to run a 30–35 minute walkthrough focused on retrieval + embeddings and EU hosting. Before we lock a time, two quick technical questions so we tailor the demo: 

1) Primary flow: will most queries be retrieval-then-embed (embedding lookup + rerank) or are you planning to do generation-heavy chat responses (long prompts + open-ended generation)?
2) Typical prompt/request size: are users sending short product queries (1–2 short sentences) or longer descriptions? Approx tokens per request helps us size the model choice and batching.
3) SLAs and latency: is 200–300ms p50 for product page responses the target, or do you have stricter limits?

Suggested windows (all in BST/PDT conversions below — let me know which works):
- Tue 5 Sep: 09:00 PDT / 17:00 BST (30 min)

Hi Michael — thanks for the quick reply and options. Answers below: 

1) Flow: primary is retrieval + embeddings with a small reranking/generation step for product description tailoring. We plan to store product vectors and do similarity search; only occasionally will we use a longer-generated description.
2) Prompt size: most queries are short — 5–30 tokens typically; retrieval documents are larger (product descriptions ~200–400 tokens).
3) Latency target: we aim for p50 < 300ms on product page UX, p90 < 600ms is tolerable.

Volume clarification: expecting ~300k requests/month in peak months, average month ~120k.

EU hosting: important for privacy. We have an internal security checklist and will likely need SOC2 evidence later in the process.

Of the times you suggested, Tue 5 Sep 09:00 PDT / 17:00 BST works for me, but could we shift it 90 minutes later (18:30 BST) because our product team has an overlapping standup? If 90 minutes later doesn't work for your side, the Wed 11:00 PDT / 19:00 BST slot is fine.

Also please send a calendar invite and record the session. I'll invite our lead engineer (cc: tbd) to join.

Cheers,
Lina
